profileText: a Senator from Alabama; born in Camden, Ark., September 18, 1954; graduated Harmony Grove High School, Camden, Ark., 1972; B.S., physical education, Southern Arkansas University, 1976; college football coach; sports broadcaster; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2020 for the term ending January 3, 2027.
